title: event log
description: An append-only log of events forming a tree by `parent`. A branch's state is the fold of the chain from the world's seed to the branch head; nothing else is state. `touches` and `removed` are written by the engine when it commits an event, never by the caller.

parent.description: the event this one follows on its branch; null only at the root

actor.description: a person id, an agent id, or 'clock'

touches.description: tiles as 'col,row', 'clock' for a tick, 'agent:<id>' for an agent, 'instance:<id>' for an instance; the merge and revert conflict rules compare these

removed_instance.description: on a remove_instance: the whole record that stood there, provenance, source and error included

removed.description: on a remove: what stood there, so a revert can put it back

place_instance_parameters.description: a proposed instance at a free millimetre position from the grid's south-west corner, x east and y north; its id is the event id and its height the type's height_mm

opt_in_parameters.description: a synthetic agent is replaced by the real person it stood for: synthetic becomes false and stated attributes overwrite drawn ones

branch_parameters.description: branch(name, from): a new head at `from`. A proposal is a branch with proposal true.

merge_parameters.description: merge(branch): the source events not yet applied on the target, in source order. Refused when any of them touches a tile the target changed since the two diverged, or when replaying them breaks a rule. A proposal merges only after an endorsement.

revert_parameters.description: revert(event): applies the inverse of a place or remove, as an action checked against the rules. Refused when a later event touched the same tiles.

endorse_parameters.description: an endorsement of the proposal branch it is appended to. weight_class is a vote class from the matchmaking vocabulary; class weights are null there, so the engine tallies by class and never sums. A synthetic agent cannot endorse.
